title: Is Night Cream Necessary? Who Needs It and Who Can Skip It
ex: A night cream helps some skin more than others. See who benefits, who can skip it, how Indian weather changes things and simple alternatives.
rt: Is Night Cream Necessary? Who Needs It | Mirc Glow
rd: Is night cream necessary? Who benefits, who can skip it, how Indian summer, monsoon, winter and AC change the answer, and simple alternatives that work.
quick: Not for everyone. Your skin needs a clean face and a moisturiser that suits it at night. A separate night cream helps if your skin feels dry or tight by morning, if you sleep in AC or live with dry winters, or if you want specific ingredients working overnight.
facts: A night cream is a moisturiser made for evening use
Oily skin in humid weather may only need a light gel
AC and winter air make skin feel drier overnight
Wear sunscreen every morning if your night cream has actives
